sn48.44:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbakoṭṭhake.
sn48.44:1.3: tatra kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi.
sn48.44:1.5: saddhindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti, amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ, viriyindriyaṃ -pe- satindriyaṃ -pe- samādhindriyaṃ -pe- paññindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānanti?
sn48.44:2.1: nakhvāhaṃ ettha bhante, bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi
sn48.44:2.2: “saddhindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ -pe- paññindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ.
sn48.44:2.3: yesaṃ hi bhante, aññātaṃ assa adiṭṭhaṃ aviditaṃ asacchikataṃ aphassitaṃ paññāya, te tattha paresaṃ saddhāya gaccheyyuṃ:
sn48.44:2.4: saddhindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ -pe- paññindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānanti.
sn48.44:2.5: yesañca kho etaṃ bhante, ñātaṃ diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ phassitaṃ paññāya, nikkaṅkhā te tattha nibbivikicchā,
sn48.44:2.6: saddhindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ -pe- paññindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ.
sn48.44:2.7: mayhampi kho etaṃ bhante, ñātaṃ diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ sacchikataṃ phassitaṃ paññāya.
sn48.44:2.8: nikkaṅkhvāhaṃ tattha nibbivikiccho saddhindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānaṃ -pe- paññindriyaṃ bhāvitaṃ bahulīkataṃ amatogadhaṃ hoti amataparāyanaṃ amatapariyosānanti.
